documentation.title: AAER dates from SEC
documentation.description: A data set containing dates and descriptions for AAERs.
documentation.details: The SEC index was refreshed through October 8, 2026. Exact duplicate rows are removed; distinct entries sharing an AAER number are retained. Source-backed corrections retain November 16, 1999 for AAER-1209 and restore AAER-1470 dated October 23, 2001. Historical entries missing from the current index are preserved, including three intentionally omitted numbers with missing dates. The malformed historical identifier AAER-x2218 is replaced by AAER-2218. Raw snapshots, historical supplements, and the correction table with release links are maintained in `data-raw`; see also the refresh investigation (https://github.com/iangow/farr/issues/27). Index dates have not all been checked against the underlying releases.
